description: Details of one conversation; with run_id, **the final result of that dispatch** (the place to collect asynchronous work). Without run_id it uses the most recent turn. Returns: title, workspace, permission tier, state, turn count, token usage, context pressure, pending approvals, and the turn's full result (answer, tools, usage, error) with its **review ticket**. **Run records are memory-only and limited to the latest 20**; after a restart or eviction the result is read back from the sentinel file, which is on disk and survives restarts.

client_run_id.description: Look the run up by the caller's idempotency key instead of run_id (only works while the run is still in memory, i.e. within the latest 20).

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

max_chars.description: Result budget (default 0 = no truncation, full result). Above 0 it applies to **both** text and structured output: the answer is cut to that length (with answer_truncated / next_offset), and structured.run.result.tools_used keeps only tool name, status and input_chars instead of full inputs. The complete result is always in sentinel_file. When a turn used many tools the default can exceed a client's per-result limit; about 8000 is a good value.

run_id.description: The run_id returned by dsh_send. Omit for the most recent turn.

name: dsh_get
title: Get conversation or run result
